metrics.paid_help: The available chat budget excludes actual spending and active reservations. The last request shows confirmed actual cost. Preparing and unreconciled requests have separate states.
metrics.free_help: Tokens remaining belong to this chat budget after usage and active reservations. They are not a global OpenRouter quota. Last request is authoritative total usage including input and response.
metrics.key_help: This limit belongs to the current API key. The chat budget and OpenRouter account balance are separate amounts.
metrics.key_not_set_help: No separate spending limit is set for this key. This does not mean unlimited account funds. The chat budget and API account balance are separate.
metrics.key_unavailable_help: Refresh the key status and account balance from the menu. A failed balance read does not by itself prevent chat requests.
metrics.without_confirmation_help: Skip the ordinary paid-request confirmation for this chat, including its first request and retries. You accept the current known model prices, including price increases. Requests with unknown prices remain blocked. Budget-risk warnings and other limits still apply. Changing this setting does not send a request.
estimate.empty: Enter a message for an estimate
estimate.help: A conservative local estimate includes the sent history and response limit. It is not exact model tokenization or expected response length. Final usage and cost are known after the request. Actual send checks still apply.
estimate.router_help: A conservative local estimate includes the sent history and response limit. The free router chooses the actual model later. Final token usage is known after the request. The estimate does not send or reserve anything.
metrics.account_help: An account snapshot returned by OpenRouter. It is separate from this chat budget and the API key limit. Refresh it from the key status menu. Billing can take a moment to appear.
budget_warning.title: Chat budget is running low
budget_warning.help: This conservative estimate includes the sent history, reply limit and active reservations. It is not the exact future cost. The warning appears when the projected chat remainder is at most 10% of its limit.
budget_warning.exceed: This request may exceed the chat spending limit. Send permits this request once. Your saved limit will not change.
budget_warning.empty: This request may use up the chat spending limit.
budget_warning.draft_changed: The draft changed. Review it and send again.
